title: Learning Calibrated and Samplable Predictive Distributions of Surface-Ocean $\Delta p$CO$_2$ Using Tabular Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21769v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO$_2$ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO$_2$ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Most existing machine-learning estimates of this field are deterministic, giving a single value per grid point, with uncertainty approximated post hoc via residuals, ensembles, or prescribed distributions. We instead learn a conditional predictive distribution for each observation: using Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, we estimate the full predictive distribution of $\Delta p$CO$_2$ (the sea-air $p$CO$_2$ difference) from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors. On a held-out SOCAT test set, Treeffuser attains the lowest continuous ranked probability score among the uncertainty-quantification methods evaluated (8.229 $\mu$atm) and the coverage closest to the nominal 68% / 95% levels (0.686 / 0

translated_title: 使用表格扩散模型学习海表ΔpCO₂的校准且可采样的预测分布
translated_abstract: 海洋吸收了近30%的人为CO₂排放，但量化这一碳汇需要从时空上稀疏的观测数据中估算海表CO₂。大多数现有的机器学习估计方法是确定性的，即每个网格点只给出单一数值，其不确定性通过残差、集成或预设分布进行事后近似。我们转而学习每个观测点的条件预测分布：使用Treeffuser——一种采用梯度提升树评分函数的条件扩散模型——我们从13个环境、空间和时间预测变量中估计ΔpCO₂（海-气pCO₂差）的完整预测分布。在留出的SOCAT测试集上，Treeffuser在所评估的不确定性量化方法中取得了最低的连续排序概率评分（CRPS，8.229 μatm），并且其覆盖率最接近名义的68%/95%水平（0.686/0...）
tldr: 该论文提出使用基于梯度提升树评分函数的条件扩散模型Treeffuser，从13个环境、空间和时间预测变量中学习海表ΔpCO₂的完整条件预测分布，在SOCAT测试集上实现了最低的CRPS（8.229 μatm）和最接近名义水平的覆盖率，为海表CO₂估算提供了校准且可采样的不确定性量化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, to learn full calibrated and samplable predictive distributions of surface-ocean ΔpCO₂ from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors, achieving the lowest CRPS (8.229 μatm) and coverage closest to nominal levels on a held-out SOCAT test set.
